name: Dainikai Imouto Senbatsu☆Sousenkyo ~366ninme no Imouto Icha Love Gojitsudan~
original_name: 第2回妹選抜☆総選挙 ～366人目の妹いちゃラブ後日談～
source:
This is the fandisk for Imosen adding the 366th imouto Artemisia. One month after the harem end, a coalition was formed with Kikka as the leader of the imouto council. Then the 366th imouto appeared as their teacher. She also started up a new party (Tachiagare Imoutou) advocating an imouto harem and happiness for all. With the coalition and the new party facing off in a dissolution election, things are lively as always at Academy Tachibana.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/07/01/july-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
